_smokeResidue: tasks / notes / critical_dates / appointments carry BPS_SMOKE_* rows from the 2026-08-10 smoke run. They were NOT cleaned up, deliberately: the Görevler screen has no delete control (TASK_ROADMAP → Smoke Bulguları (a)), and removing the rows with hand-written SQL would have destroyed the evidence for that finding. Every mutation in that run went through a migration or an app path; none went through ad-hoc SQL. These counts are therefore the CORRECT expected state — do not read them as drift, and do not 'fix' them by deleting rows. When the delete UI ships, its own smoke becomes the cleanup, and these numbers drop back.
